question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"signed"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Signed** is the past and the past participle form of the verb **"sign"**.
 
• In the given sentence, the **auxiliary verb** is** "have"** and we have to use the **past participle** form of verb after **"have"**.
 
• The sentence structure will be **have+verb(past participle)**.

The final sentence is **some of the largest UK supermarkets have signed__ up a pact promising to transform packaging and cut plastic wastage.**
